sources.title: Data-Driven Reachability Analysis and Support Set Estimation with Christoffel Functions
sources.review_notes: All 20 PDF pages (arXiv:2112.09995v1) were compared item by item with 130 dpi page renders and 200-300 dpi crops of the mathematical regions, the three algorithm boxes, Table 1 and the three figures, and with the authors' TeX source (cfun.tex, cfun_shared.tex) and .bbl. Every page was rewritten: run-in SIAM headings became real headings; all inline and display mathematics was rewritten in LaTeX from the TeX source with private macros expanded; all 28 extractor 'formula' image items were replaced by $$ blocks with \tag for the printed equation numbers ((2.1)-(2.7), (3.1)-(3.16), (4.1), (A.1)-(A.4), (B.1)-(B.11)); Problem 1, Lemmas 3.2, 3.3, 3.7-3.10, Theorems 3.4-3.6, Corollary 3.11, Remarks 3.1 and 3.12 and the seven proofs carry their printed labels in bold. Algorithms 3.1-3.3 are image crops plus transcriptions; Figures 1-3 are image crops (edges checked on wider renders) with verbatim captions; Table 1 is a CSV read on a 250-dpi crop; the symbol list of Section 1.1 is a text list. The 34 references were each compared with the page images. Omitted regions: the vertical arXiv stamp and the page number on page 1, and the running header (page number + short title or author list) on pages 2-20. Authors' typos and inconsistencies are kept and listed in the page review notes and in the conversion notes. Review was done by one agent; no independent second verifier was used.
